description: Rear wiper or rear wiper motor broken? Instead of a new motor the buyer can remove the wiper and close the hole with a plug set (cheap, simple, clean look). Pass the part number printed on the rear wiper motor or from a parts catalogue (OE, e.g. 5G0955711C, or aftermarket such as Valeo/Bosch/Topran/Febi numbers). Returns the matching plug set products with prices (pass country) and de.glasstopfen.repair_match: vehicles using that motor, each with source and an uncertain flag. Confirm the vehicle (make, model, year, body) before ordering; not in the database yet: use find_set_for_vehicle.

country.description: Destination country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (e.g. AT). Needed for final prices; without it prices are EUR estimates.

part_number.description: Rear wiper motor part number (OE or aftermarket), spaces and dashes allowed, e.g. 5G0 955 711 C.

name: find_by_wiper_motor_part_number
title: Find plug by rear wiper motor part number
